display-poster.purpose: DERMA / TRIAGE on the home hero only.

figure.purpose: Every number the model or benchmarks produce.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action on a screen: Upload Photo, Classify again.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #006A6B; color: #fff; border: none; border-radius: 0; padding: 16px 22px; font: 500 15px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #004D40; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #004D40; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action beside a primary one.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: #004D40; border: 1px solid #004D40; border-radius: 0; padding: 16px 22px; font: 500 15px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #D7F0EB; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #004D40; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Header Navigation
components.description: Uppercase links with an underline on the active screen.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 28px; font: 300 13px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav a { color: #34524E; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #004D40; } .ds-nav a.on { color: #004D40; border-bottom-color: #004D40; }

components.name: Metric Chip
components.description: Square selector for the benchmark comparison metric.
components.html: Val Macro F1Test Accuracy
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; margin-right: 8px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid #C2D9D5; font: 300 12.8px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; color: #0B3B36; background: #F8FAFC; } .ds-chip.on { border-color: #006A6B; background: #D7F0EB; color: #006A6B; }

components.name: Urgency Result Field
components.description: Opens every scan result in the urgency colour.
components.css: .ds-urgency { background: #DC2626; color: #fff; padding: 28px 24px; } .ds-urgency .lbl { font: 300 12.8px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.48px; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-urgency .cls { font: 400 56px/0.9 'Italiana', serif; margin: 14px 0 10px; } .ds-urgency .conf { font: 400 22px 'DM Mono', monospace; } .ds-urgency .conf span { font: 300 12.8px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; margin-left: 8px; }

components.name: Stat Band
components.description: Benchmark figures in ruled columns on one teal band.
components.css: .ds-stats { display: flex; background: #006A6B; color: #CCFBF1; padding: 32px; } .ds-stats div { flex: 1; padding: 0 24px; border-left: 1px solid rgba(204,251,241,0.35); } .ds-stats div:first-child { border-left: none; padding-left: 0; } .ds-stats span { display: block; font: 300 12px 'DM Sans', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.48px; } .ds-stats b { display: block; font: 400 40px 'DM Mono', monospace; margin-top: 14px; }

components.name: Arch Photo
components.description: Lesion photograph cut into an arch window.
components.css: .ds-arch { width: 160px; height: 220px; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #e9c9bd, #c99b8c); border-radius: 80px 80px 0 0; outline: 1px solid #004D40; outline-offset: -1px; }

narrative.overview:
Dermatriage reads like a printed public-health poster in teal: towering hairline capitals, flat full-bleed colour fields as section breaks, and lesion photographs cut into arch windows instead of rounded cards. The structure follows the "Toys for Joy" style reference the owner supplied, with every lavender and plum role replaced by Dermatriage's own teal family. The four clinical urgency colours are product semantics and are kept exactly.

The home screen is the poster. Scan, the exanthem library, benchmarks and records are working screens in the same world: a display title over a hairline, Light body copy, square controls, and figures set in a monospace so columns of numbers line up.
keyCharacteristics: Italiana display at weight 400 only, line-height 0.8 to 1.0, never bold.
DM Sans Light 300 for body and uppercase labels; 400 only for nav and button text.
Zero radius everywhere except the 7px footer card.
No shadows. Depth comes from stacked colour fields, arch masks and the inset footer card.
Urgency is a full-width colour field with white text, not a tinted badge.

rules.name: The Urgency Rule
rules.body: Red, amber, blue and green appear only for triage urgency: L1 #DC2626, L2 #B45309, L3 #2563EB, L4 #047857, each carrying white text. No other surface may use them.

rules.name: The One Cool Field Rule
rules.body: Sky wash and cyan are the only cool colours, used once each on the home poster.

rules.name: The Light Body Rule
rules.body: Body copy never goes heavier than 300; weight is not how this world shows emphasis. Size and the display face are.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: If a surface needs to stand out, give it a different field colour or a 1px hairline, never a shadow.

dos: Do set headlines only in Italiana at 400 and body in DM Sans Light 300.
Do use full-bleed colour fields as section breaks.
Do cut photographs into arch windows.
Do set every model output and metric in DM Mono, read from the data, never typed in.
Do say which engine produced a result: the trained PyTorch model or the offline Dart estimate.
donts: Don't use bold display type or display line-height of 1.2 or more.
Don't round photographs or cards (the 7px footer card is the only exception).
Don't use the urgency reds, ambers, blues or greens for decoration.
Don't centre every line of the word wall.
Don't present the offline estimate as the trained model's output.
